text: Someone on your site just spotted a hazard. What happens next decides whether it gets fixed, or forgotten.

This is SafeWorks: one connected system that turns what your people notice into fixes you can prove. In the next three minutes you'll see how to report a hazard, how officers assign the fix, and how managers track it all, start to finish.
Sign in with your employee code, in English, Hindi, Tamil or Kannada. Home shows your sync status, the big yellow Report button, and anything that needs you now.
Tap Report. The location is already filled in. Choose what you saw, pick a category, snap a photo and submit. You get a case number straight away.
A safety officer opens it from the Triage tab, scores likelihood and severity on your risk matrix, and assigns an owner. The due date follows the risk band.
The owner starts the work and completes it with an after-photo. A different person verifies it worked, and the report closes. The person who reported it sees that too.
When someone is in immediate danger, turn on Danger now. Your officers, site head and HSE managers are alerted at once and must acknowledge it. If nobody does, it escalates.
Bad signal on site? SafeWorks keeps working. Everything you save goes into the outbox and syncs automatically as soon as you're back in range.
Visitors and contract workers don't need an account. They scan the QR poster, report in their own language, and can stay anonymous.
Inspections work the same way. Run a checklist, mark pass or fail, add a photo, and sign. A failed item can raise a corrective action automatically.
For managers, the admin console shows live KPIs: open and overdue actions, triage backlog, on-time closure, by site, date and department. The attention board lists what needs action today.
Find any case in seconds with the command menu, and produce your monthly report with one click: a full Excel workbook, ready for the review meeting.
So that's SafeWorks: reports in seconds, fixes that are owned and verified, and a safety picture you can measure every day.
Set your language in Settings, and switch any time. Your choice follows you to the phone app, the console and your emails.
Ready to start? Choose your pilot site, scan your first poster, and make your first report today. Welcome to SafeWorks.
